source: Official Android Developers layout containers; token ranges are guarded by the complete original language token hash.
notes: Only layout wrappers are added. Prose, whitespace textContent, headings, media and links are validated unchanged.
Source ranges refer to literal character offsets in the recorded official HTML, avoiding its invalid p/div nesting.
Columns preserve original source order and media membership. Examples preserve each image with its caption. Tabs preserve each full original section.
